WHEREAS, the Town of Clermont, Georgia, adopted resolution No, 2002-05 entitled “Animal Control” on April 1, 2002, but is correcting an error in the Animal Control Ordinance adopted by the Ordinance by amending the definition of “Governing Authority” in Section 4.10.010 of said Ordinance to substitute “the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia” for “the Board of Commissioners of Hall County, Georgia”, and

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, as follows:

3:
“Definitions” is hereby amended by striking “Governing authority means the Board of Commissioners Hall County, Georgia” and inserting in it’s place “Governing authority means the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia” in the definition of “Governing Authority”.

-2-

All Ordinances or parts thereof, in conflict with the terms of this resolution are hereby repealed, but it is hereby provided that any ordinance or law, which may be applicable hereto and aid in carrying out and making effective the intent, purpose and provisions hereof, which shall be liberally construed to be in favor of Clermont, Georgia, is hereby adopted as part hereof.

It is hereby declared to be the intent of the Town Council to provide for separable and divisible parts, and its does hereby adopt any and all parts hereof as may not be held invalid for any reason.
